title: superclaude.py is executable in git, and every class verb the floor links is
intention: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py carries git mode 100755, so the floor's superclaude link dispatches and `cairn superclaude` launches; a proof reds any file the floor links as a class verb that git holds as 100644.
why: Measured 2026-11-23 on akiendelllinux: `cairn superclaude --dry-run` from the house answers rc 127 'no such verb: superclaude'. 60de22e64 (1941e93b25a3's build, made on Windows) created cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py as 100644; bin/cairn.py's _superclaude_stale/_wire_instances links ~/.cairn/devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude to it and the dispatch's _is_script refuses a file without the exec bit, so every floor walk since 03:11 replaced a working link with a dead one. The class of defect: a script born on Windows lands as 100644, because Windows has no exec bit and git there records none. The rescue launcher is down while it stands, and two proofs on main read red over it.
traces_to: Law 9 (red is the default: two proofs on main and the live rescue launcher are red) and Law 4 (a rule that matters is physics: 'a class verb is executable' becomes a proof, not a habit a Windows build forgets).
how: Set the mode with `git update-index --chmod=+x cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py` (and chmod +x in the working tree). A red-first proof beside cc reads `git ls-files -s` over the cc verbs the floor links and reds any not 100755, and launches `bin/cairn superclaude --dry-run` over a scratch instance root and needs rc 0. The two proofs the mode redded are resealed at PROVEME.

clauses.claim: every file git holds at cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and cairn/devices/cc/0/bin/* (the cc verbs the floor links) is mode 100755 in `git ls-files -s`
`bin/cairn superclaude --dry-run` over a scratch instance root (cairn/0 already made, no superclaude link) exits 0, and the link it lays resolves to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py

decisions.text: D1: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py's git mode becomes 100755 (`git update-index --chmod=+x`, and chmod +x in the tree); its bytes are unchanged.

D2: the red-first proof cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_a_class_verb_the_floor_links_is_executable_in_git.py, PROVES 846b6ca0eaf7 keys 1-2, one tooth per clause. Tooth 1 runs `git ls-files -s` from the repo root over cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and cairn/devices/cc/0/bin/* and lists every entry not 100755. Tooth 2 copies the env of bin/proofs/test_the_floor_links_a_class_verb_that_landed_late.py (_env: scratch CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT, CAIRN_BUS_HOME, CAIRN_PG_SOCKET_DIR, CAIRN_BOOT_LOG, a sudo that refuses, CAIRN_CLASS_ROOT dropped), makes devices/cairn/0, runs [*bash_script_argv(bin/cairn), 'superclaude', '--dry-run'] with cwd '/', and needs rc 0 and devices/superclaude/0/bin/superclaude resolving to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py. The proof landed red-first with a third tooth running two other components' proofs; the build deletes that tooth and its PROVES key, because a ticket's proofs measure only its own component (outline 19.6, 9.4.2.3.7.1). Those two proofs (bin/proofs/test_the_floor_links_a_class_verb_that_landed_late.py, cairn/devices/cairn/proofs/test_the_cairn_device_has_its_own_launcher.py) going green is measured at PROVEME by resealing each through bin/cairn test --seal, a seal commit of their own.

constraints: the proof never touches the live instance root: every bin/cairn launch it makes runs under a scratch CAIRN_INSTANCE_ROOT
superclaude.py's bytes are unchanged; only its mode moves
